about.title: Based in Cromwell and working across the region
paragraphs: Kevin has operated in Central Otago and the surrounding regions for 16 years, serving local homeowners and businesses.

Advanced Carpets & Restoration is based in Cromwell and works throughout Central Otago, the Southern Lakes and Maniototo. The current technicians are IICRC certified, and the business is fully insured. We use commercial equipment and give straightforward advice about what is likely to work for each job.

steps.title: Make an enquiry
steps.text: Send the property address, service needed and the best way to contact you. The enquiry arrives with our team by email.

steps.title: We check the details
steps.text: We answer normal enquiries the same day. If we need to see more of the job, we will ask you to email additional photos.

steps.title: We arrange a time
steps.text: Once we understand the work, we book a time that suits the property and the service.

steps.title: We come to the property
steps.text: Your technician arrives with the equipment needed for the job. We explain any drying time or aftercare before we leave.

faqs.question: What areas do you service?
faqs.answer: We work throughout Central Otago, the Southern Lakes and Maniototo from our base in Cromwell. This includes Cromwell, Alexandra, Clyde, Queenstown, Wanaka, Hāwea, Ranfurly and the places within the wider regions.

faqs.question: How quickly can you respond to flood or water damage?
faqs.answer: Emergency flood response is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Our normal response time is between 20 minutes and 2 hours across the full service area. Call 021 333 354 for the fastest response.

faqs.question: When will you answer my enquiry?
faqs.answer: We answer normal enquiries the same day. Our normal working hours are 9am to 5pm every day, and we answer the phone outside those hours.

faqs.question: How long does carpet take to dry after cleaning?
faqs.answer: Carpet usually takes 4 to 8 hours to dry. The temperature inside the property, weather, airflow, carpet type and level of soiling all affect the drying time.

faqs.question: Can you remove every stain?
faqs.answer: We cannot guarantee that every stain will come out. An untouched stain gives us the best chance of removing it, while household products can make later treatment harder. Tell us what caused the mark and what has already been used on it.

faqs.question: Can you treat pet stains and odours?
faqs.answer: We can assess and treat pet stains and odours. The likely result depends on the size of the affected area, how often it has happened and how deeply it has reached the carpet and underlay.

faqs.question: What should I move before the technician arrives?
faqs.answer: Please move small furniture and personal items away from the area being cleaned. Leave larger furniture in place unless we arrange something different with you.

faqs.question: Do you work with both homes and businesses?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our work is split evenly between homeowners and businesses across the region.

faqs.question: Are your technicians certified and insured?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our current technicians are IICRC certified, and the business is fully insured.

faqs.question: Can I get the likely cost before work starts?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can provide an estimate for residential work and written pricing for commercial work once we have enough detail about the job.

faqs.question: Can you clean carpet and upholstery during the same visit?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tell us about both services when you enquire so we can allow the right amount of time and bring the equipment needed.
